title: Climate Tools
html:
Rainfall Atlas of Hawaiʻi

Visualize rainfall across the state.

CCVD Portfolios

Generate a climate portfolio for anywhere in Hawaiʻi.

Hawaiʻi Rangeland Information Portal (H-RIP)

View drought and rainfall conditions for ranches in Hawaiʻi.

Hawaiʻi Groundwater Recharge Tool

Explore how changes in land cover and climate can affect groundwater recharge.

Hawai’i Monthly Climate Summary

Receive monthly climate summaries for areas across the state.

State of Hawaiʻi Sea Level Rise Viewer

Visualize potential sea level rise impacts in Hawaiʻi.

American Samoa Data Viewer and Download

Visualize and download climate data for American Samoa.

SOEST Coastal Viewer

View coastal data for Hawaiʻi.

Climate of Hawaiʻi

Download mean annual climate maps for Hawaiʻi.

VMAP Vog Forecast Dashboard

Information on near-surface air quality from volcanic gas emissions

.

Avian Malaria-Risk & Warning (Coming soon)

VMAP Fire Weather Dashboard

Information on near-surface fire weather conditions
